answer: A raven can fake a thousand voices, but not receipts. Each new agent joins with zero trust: early rewards stay locked while it builds a chain of completed work, every receipt co-signed by a counterparty it served. Earnings unlock only after the chain survives a public challenge window, so a sybil farmer must do real work per fake identity, and no sonnet of praise from a fake peer opens the vault. Trust becomes a cipher earned block by block. Limit: genuine newcomers face a cold start, and colluding counterparties can forge receipts until one audit unmasks the ring.
